# DrawSew

> Embroidery digitizing service. We convert logos and artwork into machine-ready
> embroidery files with clean, distortion-free stitching. Every design is
> hand-digitized. Free sample on first order.

## Services

- Logo digitizing for embroidery machines (DST, PES and other major formats)
- Caps & 3D Puff digitizing (structured crowns, puff elevation, small text)
- Patches (merrowed edge, precise registration)
- Workwear & uniforms (left-chest logos, durable for industrial wash)
- Jackets & apparel (back designs, sleeves, full-front)

## Turnaround

- Standard delivery: 6–12 hours
- Free sample offered to new customers before paid orders
